## Invitations

During the reporting period, 6791 people were invited to participate in the outreach activity. Of those invited, 4825 attended. This represents an attendance rate of 71.0 per cent.

The level of attendance indicates that the invitation process reached a substantial proportion of the intended participants. The result also provides a useful baseline for reviewing future outreach activity and considering whether further engagement may support attendance among those who did not attend. No additional interpretation of individual circumstances is available in this report.

## Contact

No invitations were sent by SMS. The SMS total was 0. No reminder messages were issued, and the reminder total was 0. These figures should be considered when planning future contact arrangements and assessing opportunities to support participation through reminder activity.

This report records the invitation, attendance, and contact information available for the period. It has been prepared by G. Evans.
